scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme - Tamil Nadu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu
Applicant's name must be included in the family card
Applicant must submit a family card, Aadhaar card, income certificate issued by VAO/Revenue Authorities, and a self‑declaration
benefits_summary: Cashless hospitalization with coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year on a floater basis for covered procedures.
documents_required: Income certificate issued by VAO/Revenue Authorities
